## Status
DONE

## What Changed
- `nuxt.config.ts` — Updated title, meta description, og:title, og:description, twitter:title, twitter:description to target "free resume formatter" keywords
- `pages/index.vue` — Updated `useHead` title to match new title tag
- `components/AppHeader.vue` — Updated brand tagline to new H1 text; added `brand-subheadline` element with full subheadline copy; updated CSS to support two-line brand copy block

## Key Decisions
- The `brand-tagline` in AppHeader is the only visible headline on the page, so it maps to the H1 copy. Added a new `brand-subheadline` span beneath it for the second line. Both use `text-overflow: ellipsis` so they degrade gracefully on narrow viewports without breaking the header layout.

## PR / Branch
- Branch: `seo-copy-update`
- PR: https://github.com/kimwwk/ohmydoc-using-claude-code-agent/pull/45
